name: Responsibility To Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility parents and communities have toward children, recognizing them as a heritage and reward from the LORD. Honoring and teaching children diligently in the ways of God is commanded, as seen in the call to instruct them continually in daily life and uphold parental authority. Moreover, discipline rooted in love is essential for their growth, while protecting vulnerable children from harm reflects God's justice and care for the fatherless.
